convention: Julian calendar. Azimuth clockwise from true north; geometric solar-centre elevation. UT, not modern time zone. LAT from solar hour angle.
sun_vector_formula: (cos(h)sin(A), cos(h)cos(A), sin(h)) in local ENU. Engine mapping (x,z,-y).

turbidity.basis: Clear-sky illustrative interval; no known historical weather.

sky_model: Preetham zenith xy, then Hernandez-Andres CCT. Use xy for colour rendering; CCT is an approximate label.
night_rule: No physically meaningful global sky CCT supplied below horizon. Twilight RGB and intensity are explicit scenic assumptions.

observer_xyz.basis: Proposed courtyard eye; near terrain only.

altitude_deg.basis: Maximum line slope over bilinear terrain at distances from thirty to three hundred sixty metres, clipped to available grid. Excludes house and trees; never a complete horizon.

sky_fill_gain.basis: Scenic sky fill relative to nominal directional gain.

interior_indirect_gain.basis: Scenic indirect gain; renderer exposure remains a separate implementation choice.

moon_disc_rule: Place disc from lunar azimuth/altitude; illuminate its limb toward the Sun. No directional moon light in the daytime wing.
